inputs.name: ResponseCheckInputValidator.validateCriteria.raw
inputs.description: The untyped value passed to validateCriteria, which must be an array (an empty array is accepted and returns an empty result). Each element must be a non-null, non-array object whose id and description are strings with at least one non-whitespace character, the ids must be unique within the array after trimming, and any other properties are ignored.

examples.description: The response cites at least one source document.
The response explains how to roll back the change.

outputs.name: ResponseCheckInputValidator.validateCriteria
outputs.description: The validated criteria in input order, each a new object holding only its trimmed id and trimmed description. It is returned only when every check passes, and it is an empty array when the input array is empty.

examples.description: The response cites at least one source document.
The response explains how to roll back the change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message 'Criteria must be a JSON array.' when the raw value passed to validateCriteria is not an array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message 'Each criterion needs an id and description.' when an element is null, not an object, or an array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message 'Criterion ids and descriptions must be nonempty strings.' when an element's id or description is not a string or is empty after trimming.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message 'Criterion ids must be unique.' when an element's id repeats an earlier element's id after trimming.
